competitions.role: Team Leader and AI Engineer, BRIN AIDeaNation 2026
competitions.organization: Badan Riset dan Inovasi Nasional (National Competition)
highlights: Led NUSA Aves, a passive bioacoustic monitoring system for endemic and endangered birds in Indonesia. Built the model, backend, and CLI/API. Selected as 1 of 80 national finalists.
Won the Travlr Data Challenge with provider-aware contrastive learning for accommodation quality embeddings. The submission was accepted as a first-author paper at ICoICT 2026.
